row.proto: int Ai_TrackLine_FindCornerEndAndStart(void *result, float car_dist, float query_dist, void *spline_data, int route_idx)
row.notes: was Ai_TrackLine_FindCornerEndAndRetire (renamed 2026-11-16: the tables are not retire lines). Only caller Ai_Overtake_EvaluateGap (0x14066deb4). Lane = [[spline_data+0x60][route_idx]]+0x58 (lane 4). Walks lane+0x4a0 (corner_end_line table, channel 2) for the first key > query (wrap on closed loop lane+0x88) -> result+0x18; then lane+0x4a8 (corner_start_line table, channel 3) backwards for the last key below that corner end -> result+0x20. result+0x40 = corner end distance - car distance (wrapped), result+0x44 = corner start distance - car or 1e38 when < 0 or > +0x40. Gate distance = out-node [gate+0x60+r*8]+0x40 -> +0xb4, else in-node [gate+0x70+r*8]+0x40 -> +0xb0. Returns result+0x18 != 0 && result+0x20 != 0. Table mapping proven via the AISplineData readers (types 1/2/3/5 -> gate+0xd0/+0xd8/+0xe0/+0xf0) and CompileMarkerChannel (gate+0xc8+c*8 -> lane+0x490+c*8); the earlier order brake/corner_start/corner_end/retire = +0x490..+0x4a8 was wrong. L2 2026-11-16 (engine-re racing-line round): decomp read, claims checked against the disassembly, refs from a full rel32/riprel/abs64 scan of .xtls/.xtext/.data1; blind verifier agreed. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-16 at user request (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V10742 Own read. Route = [[spline_data+0x60][car]]+0x58; finds the first key above the query distance in the table at lane+0x4a0 (wrapping on a closed loop) into result+0x18, then the last key below the corner end in lane+0x4a8 into result+0x20, and writes distances to result+0x40/+0x44. Returns both-found. Table to channel mapping cross-checked: CompileMarkerChannel (0x140677ae0) stores channel c at lane+0x490+c*8 (0x140677ee9) from gate+0xc8+c*8, corner end reader stores gate+0xd8 (channel 2), corner start reader gate+0xe0 (channel 3), so 0x4a0 = corner ends and 0x4a8 = corner starts. FindCornerEndAndStart is the right name, Retire was wrong.
